alerts.title: Significant weight gain and emerging metabolic dysregulation on DTG-based ART
alerts.message: Guidance states weight gain should be discussed when starting ART and that proactive diet and exercise advice should be given to all patients starting or switching ART, as obesity is an increasing problem particularly in women. Patient weight rose from 65 kg to 82 kg (BMI 25.6 to 32.4) over 18 months since switch to TLD, with waist 96 cm, BP 138/88 mmHg, fasting glucose 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.1%, triglycerides 212 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, and acanthosis nigricans, alongside maternal T2DM. Weight gain is temporally associated with DTG, but substantial non-drug contributors (family history, lifestyle, and the metabolic signs above) are likely and cannot be separated from drug effect on current data. Dolutegravir-associated weight gain is recognised, but the evidence here is attribution-uncertain, and no 3-monthly glucose monitoring documented in the plan was found.

evidence.recommended_action: Provide structured diet and exercise counselling now; repeat fasting glucose/HbA1c at 3-monthly intervals; screen lipids and BP; discuss weight-gain risk with the patient and assess whether continued DTG remains optimal given metabolic trajectory.
